questions.question_markdown: The present age of Rahim is five times the present age of his daughter, Savita. Seven years from now, Rahim will be three times as old as Savita. What is the present age (in years) of Rahim?
One year ago, the age of B was twice that of A. After 9 years, if the ratio of the ages of B and A would be 4 : 3, then the sum of their present ages is _____ years. _____

The ratio of present ages of A and B is 7 : 8. After 6 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 8 : 9. If C's present age is 10 years more than the present age of A, then the present age (in years) of C is: A B A C
Ghanshyam is thrice as old as Akash. 10 years ago, Ghanshyam was four times as old as Akash. What is the difference between their current ages (in years)?
Eight year ago, the ratio of ages of A and B was 5 : 4. The ratio of their present ages is 6 : 5. What will be the sum (in years) of the ages of A and B after 7 years from now?

Seven years ago, Prachi was four times as old as her daughter was at that time. Four years from now, Prachi will be two-and-a-half times as old as her daughter would then be. Find the sum of the present ages (in years) of Prachi and her daughter.

Mother told her daughter, "Seven years ago, I was seven times as old as you were then. Also, three years from now, I shall be three times as old as you will be". Find the present ages of the mother and the daughter, respectively.
10 years ago the father's age was three times the age of his son. After ten years, the father's age will be twice the age of his son. What is the ratio of their present ages?
Four years ago, Ravi was four times as old as Kavya. Seven years from now, Ravi will be three times as old as Kavya. Find the sum of their present ages.
10 years ago, the age of Sunita was thrice the age of her daughter Tanya. 10 years hence, the age of Sunita will be twice the age of Tanya. What is the ratio of their present ages?
Amit's father is aged five times more than Amit. After 6 years, he would be three and a half times of Amit's age. After further 9 years, how many times of Amit's age would he be?
The ratio of the present ages of a man and his son is 5 : 3. The average of their present ages is 32 years. What will be the ratio of their ages after six years?
The ratio between Sumit and Prakash age at present is 2 : 3. Sumit is 6 years younger than Prakash. The ratio of Sumit’s age to Prakash’s age after 6 years will be.
The sum of the ages of a son and father is 52 years; After four years the father's age will be four times the son's age. What is the present age (in years) of the son?

The sum of the present ages of father and a son is 52 years. Four years hence, the son’s age will be 1 4 that of the father. What will be the ratio of the ages of the son and father,10 years from now?
The ratio of ages of A and B, 8 years ago, was 2:3. Four years ago, the ratio of their ages was 5:7. What will be the ratio of their ages 8 years from now?
Five year ago, the ratio of the ages of A and B was 3 : 4. Five years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 4:5. What is the ratio of A and B, 10 years form now ?

One year ago, the ratio of the age (in years) of A to that of B was 4:3. The ratio of their respective ages, 3 years from now, will be 6:5. What will be the ratio of respective ages of A and B, 9 years from now?

The present age of a husband and wife is in the ratio 5 : 4. After 6 years their ages will be in the ratio 6 : 5. At the time of their marriage the ratio of their ages was 4 : 3. How many years ago they were married?

The ratio of the ages of A and B, 3 years ago, was 5 : 7. The ratio of their ages, 13 years from now, will be 9 : 11. If the present age of C is 11 years less than that of B, then the present age of C, in years, is:

The ratio of the ages of A and B, 8 years ago, was 5 : 7. The ratio of their ages, 8 years from now, will be 9 : 11. If the present age of C is 13 years less than that of B, and the present age of D is 8 years less than that of the age of A, then the sum of the present ages of C and D, in years, is:
The difference between the ages of father and son is 15 years. 5 years ago the age of the father was twice the age of his son. Find the present age of both of them.
Rahul’s age is three times the age of his daughter. After 8 years from now, his age will be 5 years more than twice the age of his daughter. Find the present age of Rahul.

Three years ago, the age of a person was six times the age of his younger brother. Eight years later, the age of the person will be three years less than twice the age of his younger brother. Find the present ages of the person and his younger brother.
Six years ago, the average of the ages of Ravi, Mohan and Govind was 32 years. If Shyam joins them now, the average of the ages of all four of them is 36 years. The present age of Shyam is:

The ages of two friends, Ram and Ravi, difference by 7 years. Ram's mother Mayadevi is three times as old as Ram, and Ravi is four times as old as his brother Soham. The ages of Mayadevi and Soham difference by 65 years. Find the age of Mayadevi (in years).

P got married 15 years ago. Today her age is $3\frac{1}{5}$ times her age at the time of her marriage. At present her son's age is $\frac{1}{5}$ of her age. What was her son's age 4 years ago as a fraction of P's age at that time?

In a family, the combined age of husband, wife and a son is 90 years. The husband is the oldest. The difference in the ages of the husband and wife is 1 3 rd the age of 3 their son. After 10 years, the age of the son would be half the age of his father. What is the present age of his mother (in years)? combined age
At present, A is thrice as old as B. C is 5 years elder than B. The sum of the ages of A, B, C is 75 years. The ratio of the age of B five years ago to the age of A three years from now is: ABCB

The present age (in years) of Arun is one year less than two times the present age (in years) of Varun. After 5 years from now, Varun's age will be equal to two-third of the present age of Arun. What is the sum of ages (in years) of Arun and Varun, after 2 years from now?

Five years ago, the age of A was three times the age of B. Ten years ago the age of A was half the age of C. If 'c' represents the present age of C, which of the following options represents the present age of B? AC'c' C

Anil and Beena are friends and the difference between their ages is 5 years. Anil's father Dinesh is three times as old as Anil and Beena is twice as old as her sister Charu. The ages of Dinesh and Charu difference by 45 years. If Beena is older than Anil, then find the sum of the present ages of both Dinesh and Charu.
